registry.name: Jersey — Public Service careers
registry.authority: Government of Jersey — Jersey Public Service
registry.notes: Government Jobs in Jersey page separates public-service portal from private-sector jobs. Sample Lecturer - Media Studies is permanent/full-time, closes 11 October 2026 date-only and requires candidate to be entitled for work. Residential/employment status, immigration permission and nationality are separate. Recruitment policy version 1.2 effective 27 March 2026 permits licensed recruitment only in limited circumstances; it does not guarantee sponsorship for every post. Lecturer criteria include level-two literacy/numeracy and fluent effective communication, without a named language or CEFR threshold. Work-permit policy Appendix 3 states English CEFR B1 across four skills for applicable routes, IELTS for UKVI 4.0 overall and each component, with exemptions/alternative proofs; this is immigration evidence, not a universal job-entry requirement.
registry.accessGap: Reader-only discovery awaiting review; no adapter, retained originals, accepted connector or published cycle. Exact candidate employment status, immigration exceptions, licensed permission, qualifications, amendments, application opening/timezone and language-route applicability require review. General moving-to-Jersey page simplifies work-permit rules; detailed policy lists additional exemptions and controls interpretation. Permit English B1 must not override the sample's entitled-for-work restriction or substitute for qualifications. Current employees use separate internal Connect People portal. Complete public-authority and other-pathway coverage unverified.

registry.notes: Government recruitment department identifies external press notices and separate internal circulars. Job Opportunities archive includes passed deadlines, not only open applications. Expression of Interest closed 9 September; written selection at Bayside Comprehensive School was scheduled 19 September 09:00–12:00, with later full applications only after qualifying exam pass. Right of abode is separate from nationality; external public recruitment does not mean every foreign citizen qualifies. English school qualification is not CEFR. Government banner clock is not evidence of governing deadline timezone.
